 ◢◤ ◆ Manage › Maintenance                    
 Maintenance                                  
                                              
 ▌  Task                                      
 ▌   ○ Services    ○ Disk    ◉ Vacuum         
 ▌   ○ Upgrade    ○ Compress    ○ Tags        
 ▌   ○ Uninstall                              
 ▌  Give the disk space of deleted rows       
 ▌  back (Postgres VACUUM). Do it after       
 ▌  deleting a lot, e.g. after compressing    
 ▌  Synapse's state.                          
                                              
    Kind of vacuum                            
     ◉ Complete (FULL, ANALYZE; services stop 
     ○ Full (services stop)                   
     ○ Plain (services keep running)          
     ○ Plain + ANALYZE (services keep running 
     ○ ANALYZE only (fastest)
